caption: One array, three calls: average returns 61.25, filter keeps 72 and 90, and map gives 50, 77, 95, 43. Each arrow builds a new value; marks itself stays 45, 72, 90, 38.

spec.title: Three calls on marks = [45, 72, 90, 38]
spec.aria: The marks array 45, 72, 90, 38 feeds three calls: average returns 61.25, filter of 60 or more returns 72 and 90, and map with plus 5 returns 50, 77, 95, 43.
